projects.name: SyncStream
projects.summary: Event-driven database projection pipeline using PostgreSQL WAL capture.
projects.adr: Chose CDC over polling to eliminate synchronization lag and database read amplification.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Polling
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Simple deployment, but excessive database read amplification.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Dual Writes
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Lower infrastructure complexity, but consistency drift during database/cache failures.

projects.tradeoff: Additional operational overhead (Kafka/Debezium) in exchange for near real-time consistency and removal of polling synchronization.
projects.whatNext: Support schema evolution, add replay tooling, and configure multi-region Kafka replication.

projects.name: CVE Automation Pipeline
projects.summary: Security triage pipeline mapping vendor advisories to local software dependencies.
projects.techFlow: Vendor Advisories → Ingestion Engine → LLaMA-2 Evaluator → VEX Report
scaleContext: Analyst triage time reduced from hours to minutes
projects.adr: Chose local LLaMA-2 inference over OpenAI APIs to prevent enterprise data leaks and contain costs.

rejectedAlternatives.name: SaaS LLM API
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Violated compliance regulations regarding advisory exposure.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Regex Matching
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Incapable of reasoning through hardware configurations and software exploit context.

projects.tradeoff: Higher local hardware infrastructure provisioning requirements in exchange for absolute security compliance.
operationalConcerns: Analyst override and audit trail mapping
projects.whatNext: Extend to active exploit validation (safe sandboxed runs) and OIDC-signed audit logs.

projects.name: Case-Aware Dual Memory Agent
projects.summary: Retrieval architecture combining knowledge memory and case memory for LLM support ticketing.
projects.techFlow: User Prompt → Dynamic Retriever → Case/Vector Match → LLM Context Solver
projects.adr: Chose hierarchical case memory mapping to reuse historical resolutions before calling vector retrieval.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Naïve RAG
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Produced high token overhead and retrieval drift under long contexts.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Static Fine-Tuning
rejectedAlternatives.reason: High compute costs and unable to dynamically ingest support workflow shifts.

projects.tradeoff: Additional routing logic complexity in exchange for a 40% reduction in LLM token consumption.
projects.whatNext: Implement automatic case promotion pipelines and decaying memory aging algorithms.

projects.name: Cyber-Physical Grid FDI Detection
projects.summary: Graph-based anomaly detector identifying malicious SCADA grid telemetry.
projects.techFlow: SCADA Telemetry → Graph Neural Network → Anomaly Classifier
projects.adr: Chose Graph Neural Network (GNN) modeling to capture spatial and electrical topological features.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Standard Autoencoder
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Ignored power line routing and grid topology connections, lowering precision.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Statistical Thresholding
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Vulnerable to coordinated stealth attacks masquerading as load changes.

projects.tradeoff: Longer model training latencies in exchange for 95%+ false data injection detection accuracy.
failureModes: False positive flags during grid reconfigurations
projects.whatNext: Incorporate temporal-GNN layers to capture transient wave oscillations.

projects.name: Medical Imaging KNN Search
projects.summary: DenseNet feature extraction + Faiss indexing for image similarity queries.
projects.techFlow: Medical Scans → DenseNet Encoder → Faiss KNN Finder
projects.adr: Chose Faiss indexes over standard SQL lookups to obtain low-latency retrieval speeds on vector data.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Brute-force Cosine Search
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Exhibited O(N) search scaling, exceeding the 10ms latency budget.

rejectedAlternatives.name: LSH indexing
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Too many approximation errors, lowering search precision.

projects.tradeoff: Higher RAM storage footprint in exchange for fast similarity search queries.
failureModes: Semantic similarity mismatch on raw embeddings
costConsiderations: Optimized CPU query pipelines minimizing dedicated cluster charges
projects.whatNext: Support hierarchical indexing structures for multi-modal imaging feature vectors.

projects.name: Line Outage Network Optimization
projects.summary: Matrix-based topology solver for transmission networks.
projects.techFlow: Phase Telemetry → Graph Laplacian → Sparse Matrix Solver
projects.adr: Chose topological sparse matrix algorithms to solve line outages directly without data-hungry estimators.

rejectedAlternatives.name: ML Regression Classifier
rejectedAlternatives.reason: High training lag and vulnerable to topology layout shifts.

projects.tradeoff: Requires complete, accurate network matrices in exchange for fault localization.
costConsiderations: Lightweight algorithmic execution with negligible CPU consumption bills
projects.whatNext: Incorporate active line outage estimation modules for missing node connections.
